en: GS - I am GS, a ranger from Dagal. I wish to see the Grand Duke.
Soldier 1 - You want to see the Grand Duke? Hey, we've got suspicious characters here!
Soldier 2 - Well, they're all armed. Let's disarm them first!
GS - Listen, I'm GS, a ranger and a friend of Grand Duke Mozel. If you send word to him, he can vouch for me.

Soldier 1 - Grand Duke Mozel was killed by assassins days ago. And the Senate has ordered the arrest of anyone suspicious passing through Bifrost. I don't know whether you're guilty or not, but you'll have to come with us!
GS - What... Grand Duke Mozel... What on earth is happening in Bifrost?
Soldier 2 - You can explain later. All of you, drop your weapons!
GS - We can't do that. We carry an important message from Dagal. If you mistreat us, you'll pay for it!
Soldier 1 - Heh heh heh. If we let you go, we'll pay for it today. Stop talking and drop your weapons quietly.
GS - Then there's no choice. Everyone, flee to the mountains to the north! We'll have to hide there and see how things turn out.
